Explanatory Notes
Our systems are not designed to calculate in totality materials in this way. See our Making Silicon 
Chips web site for a detailed description of the manufacturing process and materials used. 
Given the complexity and size of our products, calculation of the percentage of recycled content 
is not applicable; more significant are our efforts in recent years to design out materials such as 
lead and halogens.
See also our CDP questionnaire response on the CDP web site.
Our purchased energy is from multiple public utilities, which include a mix of energy sources. 
We do not break out total consumption by source. See also our response on the CDP web site.
Major locations and manufacturing sites are listed in this report, and owned and leased  
facilities are listed in our 2012 Annual Report and Form 10-K (p 8, 22).
See also our response on the CDP web site.
